text:
sanjay_cs: FYI - Pondera's activation shows chat P95 ~850ms and avg tokens-per-request jumped to 1.8k after enabling full transcript. Renewal touchpoint in 10 days, we need a quick ops improvement to present to the customer. :alarm_clock:
eli_se: ack. looking at traces now. major hotspot is attention on long-history turns + repeated system logs in messages. cache hit nearly zero since contexts vary a lot.
tayla_eng: quick idea: route by token-length + intent tag. low-token queries -> rdx-lite-int8, long conversational threads -> rdx-large-fp16 with aggressive KV caching + prefix trimming. also enable response-length cap for system messages.
anya_am: looping AE now but need concrete delta numbers. can we estimate cost drop and latency p95 improvement before we talk to them?
eli_se: I can run a micro-eval on 250 representative sessions. will compare int8 vs fp16 on quality metrics (exact-match, rouge, and a small human pass). ETA 18h.
tayla_eng: proposed canary policy snippet:
```
route: pondera-chat
policies:
  - condition: request.tokens <= 300
    model: rdx-lite-int8-v2
    quant: int8
    cache: prefix:true
  - condition: request.tokens > 300
    model: rdx-large-fp16-v3
    cache: kv:true
    max_response_tokens: 512
fallbacks:
  on_error_rate_gt: 1%
    switch_to: rdx-large-fp16-v3
rollout: 5% -> 30% over 72h
```
sanjay_cs: perfect. include a note to sanitize pasted logs (strip stack traces) - that alone may cut tokens 30% on many threads.
eli_se: will add a small preprocessing step in the canary to remove common log patterns and long timestamps.
anya_am: AE asked for ROI slide: need projected % cost reduction, expected p95 delta, and risk notes. can we aim for 15-25% cost reduction and 150-300ms p95 improvement?
tayla_eng: realistic: 18-22% cost saving on tail-heavy workloads and 120-260ms p95 gain if caching kicks in. quality regressions should be minimal based on prior int8 checks; we'll run the 250-sample QA to confirm.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for Pondera chat route - start=2965436000 window=72h initial_weight=5% monitor: latency,cost,fallback_rate
eli_se: action items: 1) run 250-sample eval and post metrics (ETA 18h) 2) tayla to draft canary + rollback playbook 3) anya to prep AE ROI slide 4) sanjay to coordinate dataset and customer PM sync after 24h results
sanjay_cs: noted. I'll ask the PM for a sanitized sample dataset and set up the post-canary customer check-in.
anya_am: will add a renewal note in Salesforce once we have the first-day numbers. also capture any qualitative feedback from the PM about hallucinations or format changes.
eli_se: starting eval now. will include side-by-side int8/fp16 outputs and a small human label pass for 50 critical examples.
tayla_eng: remember to enable tracing flags so we can attribute latency to kernel vs serialization vs network. helps RCA if anything regresses.
sanjay_cs: thanks everyone. objective: have a short one-pager and a clear canary result before the renewal call. :muscle:
